pages.title: Construction
pages.text: The Observer Anchor (prototype) is the only deployable reality stabilisation device in the field.$(br2)Its construction is extremely crude: four iron legs, four redstone, one eye of ender. What makes it work is that it knows where to look.

$(bold)Deployment:$() The anchor accepts one OBSR model in its slot.$(br2)$(li)With no model inserted the anchor produces no effect and serves only as decoration;$(br)$(li)once a model is inserted it takes effect immediately, and its area of effect is a square region centred on the anchor, equal in extent along each axis (Chebyshev radius).

At the moment of insertion the anchor first solidifies the blocks in range to their current state, and only then applies protection.$(br2)Registering protection directly would latch a pre-drift state, and the blocks that had not yet defocused would never change again.
$(bold)Removal:$() Removing or swapping a model takes effect immediately, with no retroactive change. Changes that have already occurred will not be restored because of it.
